title: RHEL 10 must have the "gnutls-utils" package installed.
check_content:
Verify RHEL 10 has the "gnutls-utils" package installed with the following command:

$ sudo dnf list --installed gnutls-utils
Installed Packages
gnutls-utils.x86_64                         3.8.9-9.el10_0.14                         @rhel-10-for-x86_64-appstream-rpms

If the "gnutls-utils" package is not installed, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Configure RHEL 10 to have the "gnutls-utils" package installed with the following command:

$ sudo dnf -y install gnutls-utils
VulnDiscussion: "GnuTLS" is a secure communications library implementing the Secure Sockets Layer (SSL), Transport Layer Security (TLS), and Datagram TLS (DTLS) protocols and technologies around them. It provides a simple C language application programming interface (API) to access the secure communications protocols as well as APIs to parse and write X.509, PKCS #12, OpenPGP, and other required structures. This package contains command line TLS client and server and certificate manipulation tools.
